findings.title: Water supply coverage in Gulu municipality
findings.summary: Gulu's water supply system covers the municipality and peri-urban areas but meets only about one third of total water demand.

findings.title: Groundwater characteristics in Uganda
findings.summary: Most boreholes in Uganda tap groundwater from weathered and fractured basement aquifers, with depths mostly less than 80 m and yields varying widely.

findings.title: Water contamination risks in Gulu District
findings.summary: Contamination of drinking water in Gulu can cause acute water-borne diseases such as cholera, dysentery, and typhoid.

findings.title: Gulu clean water supply project launched
findings.summary: A 2.1 billion shilling project was launched in 2025 to expand safe drinking water supply and protect natural water sources in Gulu City.

findings.title: Water sources status in Gulu District (2010)
findings.summary: A 2010 report details operational status and accessibility of water sources in Gulu District.

findings.title: Permeability of weathered bedrock aquifers in Uganda
findings.summary: Most boreholes in Uganda are deeper than 50 m with average depth around 70 m; transmissivity varies significantly with depth category.

findings.title: Predictors of water point sustainability in Gulu
findings.summary: Water source technology types and contamination risk scores predict sustainability and water quality of nonpiped water sources in Gulu.

findings.title: Gulu Water Supply and Sanitation Project
findings.summary: Construction started on a water supply and sanitation project serving over 341,000 people in Gulu and surrounding areas, drawing water from the Nile at Karuma.

findings.title: WASH assessment in Gulu District
findings.summary: A 2022 WASH assessment identified severe water shortages in Gulu District, especially in Paico and Bungatila sub-counties.

findings.title: Uganda borehole and transmissivity dataset
findings.summary: A digital dataset includes over 655 borehole records with metadata and pumping test data across Uganda including Gulu.

findings.title: Water contamination and flooding in Gulu City
findings.summary: Flooding during rainy seasons contaminates water sources in Gulu City, causing challenges in water quality and supply.

findings.title: Karuma-Gulu water project construction
findings.summary: Construction began in 2022 on the Karuma-Gulu water project including treatment plant and pipelines to Gulu city and peri-urban towns.

findings.title: Household water source and collection in Northern Uganda
findings.summary: Most households collect drinking water from protected sources but water quantity is below minimum standards and collection times are high.

findings.title: Water point failure case study in Uganda
findings.summary: Most water points in studied districts are deep boreholes (40-60 m) tapping weathered regolith and fractured bedrock aquifers with groundwater levels 1-5 m below ground.

findings.title: Catchment vulnerability in Gulu City
findings.summary: Gulu City lies in catchments vulnerable to dry spells; recent climate change has dried key water sources and micro-catchment degradation is worsened by human activities.

findings.title: Rehabilitation of war-time piped water schemes in Gulu
findings.summary: Gulu district plans to rehabilitate six abandoned piped water schemes originally built for displaced persons during the LRA insurgency.
